reading: A Kanban board sketch: a 56px top bar with filter links/pills and a search field, four column headers (To do, In progress, Review, Done) each with a trailing count, two dashed section dividers labeled 'WEB APP' and 'MOBILE', and a set of task cards (with tag chips, titles, avatar dots, progress bars, and two completed/struck-through cards) laid out under each divider.
